## F — Research and VERIFY index: Night, work zones, winter and rural driving

Research index: Night, work zones, winter and rural driving; mapped physical pages 66, 67.
Part C contains 20 knowledge facts and part C2 contains 17 continuation facts. Individual source anchors and preaccept receipts preserve traceability.
VERIFY index: sec18-COUNT — exact official question count; sec18-PASS — exact official passing score; sec18-TIME — exact official duration; sec18-CADENCE — revision frequency.
Market and competitor debts: SEC-SPECIAL-MARKET and SEC-SPECIAL-COMPETITORS. Source-specific cautions are in part D.
Revision stability remains unknown, so the dossier carries a blocked-probe flag pending evidence; factual compilation is not independent QA or release acceptance.
VERIFY sec18-WINTER-BRAKING-ABS-SCOPE: Physical page67 recommends gentle brake pumping without an ABS distinction, while page57 requires sustained ABS pressure. Verify applicable vehicle instructions before learner-facing brake-procedure guidance; do not treat either as universal.
VERIFY sec18-WORKZONE-INJURY-STATISTIC: Physical page66 gives an annual work-zone injury count without a dated dataset. Do not present it as current measured incidence before dated primary verification.

corpus_stability.reason: The official dated snapshot is pinned, but revision frequency has not been measured. Unknown cadence remains blocked for release pending the section-A verification debt; this is not a claim that the handbook is volatile.
